text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Tuesday, July 31, 2018 Posted by admin on July 31st, 2018
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +9 points.
Monday the Dow was down -144.23 (-0.57%) at 25,306.83.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +2.38%.
There were 16 Dow stocks up Monday.
The Dow stock winners Monday were led byMerck (MRK) +2.08% and Chevron (CVX) +1.48%.
The Dow stock losers Monday were led by Visa (V) -3.01% and American Express (AXP) -2.89%.
Intel (INTC +0.02%) was upgraded to ‘Buy’ from ‘Hold’ at DZ Bank AG with a price target of $55.
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended mostly hiigher.
The national average price of gasoline is up five-tenths of a cent at $2.862 per gallon.
